description: This file defines the CharCountBased class within the FastRoute\Dispatcher namespace. It extends an abstract class and implements route dispatching logic based on character count and regex matching, specifically handling variable routes.

classes.name: CharCountBased
classes.description: A class responsible for dispatching routes based on character count and regex matching within the FastRoute routing library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CharCountBased dispatcher with route data, separating static and variable route mappings.

methods.name: dispatchVariableRoute
methods.description: Handles dispatching for variable routes by matching the URI against regex patterns and extracting variables from matched routes.
